city_of_sydney|private_open_space|dwelli.note: NEW. The clause heading on the page is literally '4.1.3.5 Private open space', inside Part 4.1, whose sub-parts on these pages are dwelling-house and secondary-dwelling controls. 'minimum area of 16sqm' is a requirement, and there is no concession to strand in the condition. 16sqm reads small against Parramatta's 100m2; that is what a dense inner-city LGA states, not an extraction error.

Correct reading, but not a second control. It restates the SAME 16sqm as 4.1.3.5, in the form of a precondition: a secondary dwelling on a lot under 150sqm is only permitted if the principal dwelling keeps its 16sqm. Served as its own row it would answer the POS question twice with one number, and the second answer would carry a lot-size qualifier that has nothing to do with the POS requirement itself.

city_of_sydney|private_open_space|reside.note: NEW. '(a) ground level dwellings: 25sqm with a minimum dimension of 4m' -- unambiguous, and the general apartment control rather than a precinct one. GRAIN checked: the value is the POS area and the 4m dimension correctly stays in the condition instead of being stored as the value.

NEW. '(b) upper level units: 10sqm with a minimum dimension of 2m' -- the same clause's upper-level limb. Ground and upper are genuinely different controls with different numbers, so two rows is right here, unlike the 4.1.6.1(2) restatement above.

city_of_sydney|private_open_space|boardi.note: NEW, and the qualifier is load-bearing: this is not 4sqm of POS for every boarding house room. The clause requires 30% OF ALL BEDROOMS to have access to at least 4sqm as a balcony or terrace. A consumer reading value_min without that would apply it to every room. Qualifier moved to the front of the condition so it cannot be missed.

corrections.condition: APPLIES TO 30% OF ALL BEDROOMS, not every bedroom -- each of that 30% must have access to private open space of at least 4sqm, in the form of a balcony or terrace area.

parramatta|private_open_space|boarding_h.note: NEW, but dangerously narrow if served plainly. This is the POS for an ON-SITE MANAGER'S accommodation in a boarding house -- not the POS a boarding house provides for its residents. Parramatta has no general boarding-house POS row, so a consumer asking the obvious question would get 8m2 and be wrong. Qualifier moved to the very front of the condition.

corrections.condition: ON-SITE MANAGER'S ACCOMMODATION ONLY -- this is not the boarding house's resident POS requirement. Where accommodation is provided for an on-site manager, one area of at least 8m2 with a minimum dimension of 2.5 metres, adjacent to that accommodation and not in the front setback area.
